const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p='.ai/task/batch-75066ae8e14952b37c96/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-lane-000-2.json'
with open(p,encoding='utf-8') as f: e=json.load(f)
issues={0:'将龙可能早于其他种族、是元素原始化身的假说改写成龙形成较早因而具有元素亲和力；又把巨龙守护金山的传闻译成以拥有金币为傲。',2:'原文冒号后保留空格，译文删除了尾随空格。',13:'原文冒号后保留空格，译文删除了尾随空格。',14:'将 dreamselves（梦中的自身投影）译成“梦境守卫”，误添守卫身份。'}
entries=e['payload']['entries']
assert len(entries)==20
results=[]
for i,x in enumerate(entries):
 r={'entry_revision_identity':x['entry_revision_identity'],'verdict':'ISSUE' if i in issues else 'OK'}
 if i in issues:r['observation']=issues[i]
 results.append(r)
assert [r['entry_revision_identity'] for r in results]==[x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in entries]
assert len({r['entry_revision_identity'] for r in results})==20
print(json.dumps({'candidate_identity':e['candidate_identity'],'contract':'translation_surface_screen_v1','results':results},ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')),end='')
PY",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",max_output_tokens:10000});text(r.output)
